description: A coalition of EU member states, alarmed by the US restriction of frontier AI access and the vulnerability exposed by the cyber_test_shot, initiates a fast-tracked joint program to build a sovereign European AI testbed using existing scientific infrastructure and ASML-linked semiconductor research. The project is framed as a continuity-of-service measure rather than a challenge to US leadership, but it marks the first coordinated move toward operational autonomy in AI development. Momentum is fragile and depends on holding consensus through 2027.
